nodes.name: Whole-number place value and magnitude
nodes.definition: Interpret whole numbers using base-ten units, relative size, and positions on a number line.

nodes.name: Whole-number addition and subtraction
nodes.definition: Combine, separate, and compare whole-number quantities, including regrouping across place values.

nodes.name: Whole-number multiplication and division
nodes.definition: Reason about equal groups, multiplicative comparisons, products, and quotients.

nodes.name: Factors and multiples
nodes.definition: Identify divisibility relationships, including common factors and common multiples.

nodes.name: Fraction meaning
nodes.definition: Interpret a fraction as a number, a quantity of equal-sized parts, and a quotient.

nodes.name: Equivalent fractions
nodes.definition: Generate, recognize, and simplify fractions that represent the same number.

nodes.name: Fraction addition and subtraction
nodes.definition: Add and subtract nonnegative fractions by expressing quantities in common fractional units.

nodes.name: Fraction multiplication and division
nodes.definition: Multiply and divide nonnegative fractions using scaling, grouping, and reciprocal relationships.

nodes.name: Decimal place value
nodes.definition: Interpret decimal digits as tenths, hundredths, and successive powers-of-ten fractional units.

nodes.name: Decimal operations
nodes.definition: Add, subtract, multiply, and divide nonnegative decimals while accounting for place value.

nodes.name: Fraction–decimal conversion
nodes.definition: Express fractions as terminating or repeating decimals and terminating decimals as fractions.

nodes.name: Signed numbers and order
nodes.definition: Interpret positive and negative integers, opposites, zero, and order on a number line.

nodes.name: Integer addition and subtraction
nodes.definition: Add and subtract integers using signed changes, opposites, and additive inverses.

nodes.name: Integer multiplication and division
nodes.definition: Multiply and divide integers with consistent reasoning about signs.

nodes.name: Signed rational-number operations
nodes.definition: Compute with positive and negative fractions and decimals, including mixed representations.

nodes.name: Ratios
nodes.definition: Interpret an ordered comparison of quantities in multiplicative terms.

nodes.name: Unit rates
nodes.definition: Determine and interpret an amount per one unit, including rates involving fractions.

nodes.name: Proportional reasoning
nodes.definition: Recognize equivalent ratios and determine missing quantities through consistent multiplicative scaling.

nodes.name: Percent representations
nodes.definition: Interpret percent as a rate per hundred and express it using fractions and decimals.

nodes.name: Percent problem solving
nodes.definition: Determine a part, whole, percentage, or percent change using proportional relationships.

nodes.name: Whole-number exponents
nodes.definition: Interpret and evaluate powers with positive whole-number exponents as repeated multiplication.

nodes.name: Integer exponent laws
nodes.definition: Apply product, quotient, and power laws, including zero and negative exponents with appropriate nonzero bases.

nodes.name: Order of operations
nodes.definition: Evaluate numerical expressions using grouping, exponents, and conventional operation precedence.

nodes.name: Commutative and associative properties
nodes.definition: Recognize when reordering or regrouping addition or multiplication preserves a value.

nodes.name: Distributive property
nodes.definition: Understand why multiplying a sum or difference equals combining the corresponding products.

nodes.name: Meaning of equality
nodes.definition: Interpret the equals sign as asserting that two quantities or expressions have the same value.

nodes.name: Variables
nodes.definition: Interpret a symbol as an unknown, a varying quantity, or an arbitrary number.

nodes.name: Algebraic expression structure
nodes.definition: Read and construct expressions, identifying terms, coefficients, factors, powers, and grouping.

nodes.name: Substitution and expression evaluation
nodes.definition: Replace variables with specified rational values and compute the resulting expression.

nodes.name: Equivalent linear expressions
nodes.definition: Rewrite linear expressions with rational coefficients through distribution, factoring, and combining like terms.

nodes.name: Equations and their solutions
nodes.definition: Interpret an equation as a condition and a solution as a value that makes it true.

nodes.name: Properties of equality
nodes.definition: Preserve equality by applying the same valid operation to both sides, avoiding division by zero.

nodes.name: Inverse operations
nodes.definition: Recognize how addition and subtraction, and multiplication and division, undo one another.

nodes.name: Solving linear equations in one variable
nodes.definition: Solve rational-coefficient linear equations, including variables on both sides and zero, one, or infinitely many solutions.

nodes.name: Inequalities and their solution sets
nodes.definition: Interpret inequalities as ordered comparisons and describe satisfying values, including number-line representations.

nodes.name: Solving linear inequalities in one variable
nodes.definition: Isolate a variable while preserving the solution set, reversing order when multiplying or dividing by a negative.

nodes.name: Coordinate plane
nodes.definition: Locate and interpret ordered pairs on scaled perpendicular axes, including negative and fractional coordinates.

nodes.name: Covarying quantities
nodes.definition: Represent corresponding values of two varying quantities using ordered pairs and tables.

nodes.name: Representing proportional relationships
nodes.definition: Connect equivalent-ratio tables, equations of the form y = kx, and straight-line graphs through the origin.

nodes.name: Linear relationships
nodes.definition: Recognize a constant rate of change between quantities, allowing a nonzero initial value.

nodes.name: Slope
nodes.definition: Interpret and calculate Δy/Δx as a line’s rate of change; recognize undefined slope for vertical lines.

nodes.name: Graphing linear equations
nodes.definition: Graph two-variable linear equations using slope, intercepts, or equivalent forms, including horizontal and vertical lines.

nodes.name: Functions
nodes.definition: Recognize a correspondence that assigns exactly one output to each allowed input.

nodes.name: Function notation and evaluation
nodes.definition: Interpret f(x) as an output and evaluate a function rule at specified inputs.

nodes.name: Constructing linear models
nodes.definition: Construct a linear function from a table, graph, two points, or contextual rate and initial value.

nodes.name: Systems and simultaneous solutions
nodes.definition: Interpret a linear system’s solution as an ordered pair satisfying every equation simultaneously.

nodes.name: Solving linear systems algebraically
nodes.definition: Solve two-variable linear systems through substitution or elimination and identify the number of solutions.

nodes.name: Solving linear systems graphically
nodes.definition: Determine or estimate shared solutions from intersecting, parallel, or coincident lines.
